chapters.title: Not ashamed of the gospel
chapters.summary: Paul greets the church in Rome and says the gospel is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes. Humanity has suppressed the truth about God and turned to idols.

chapters.title: God judges impartially
chapters.summary: Those who judge others do the same things. God judges everyone fairly, and His kindness is meant to lead to repentance.

chapters.title: All have sinned
chapters.summary: Jew and Gentile alike are under sin; none is righteous. All have sinned and fall short of God's glory, and are justified freely by His grace through Jesus.

chapters.title: Abraham believed God
chapters.summary: Abraham was counted righteous by faith before he was circumcised, so he is the father of all who believe. He trusted God's promise against all hope.

chapters.title: Peace with God
chapters.summary: Justified by faith, we have peace with God. God shows His love in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us. Grace reigns through Christ, the new Adam.

chapters.title: Dead to sin, alive to God
chapters.summary: Shall we keep sinning so grace may increase? No. In baptism we die and rise with Christ. The wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life.

chapters.title: The struggle within
chapters.summary: The law is holy, yet sin uses it. Paul describes the struggle of doing what he hates: O wretched man that I am! Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ.

chapters.title: No condemnation
chapters.summary: There is no condemnation for those in Christ. The Spirit helps us in weakness, all things work together for good, and nothing can separate us from the love of God.

chapters.title: God's choice
chapters.summary: Paul grieves for Israel and explains that God's promises were never based on ancestry alone, but on His mercy and calling.

chapters.title: Whoever calls on His name
chapters.summary: If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised Him, you will be saved. Faith comes by hearing the word.

chapters.title: The olive tree
chapters.summary: God has not rejected Israel. Gentiles are grafted into the olive tree, and all Israel will be saved. O the depth of the riches and wisdom of God!

chapters.title: A living sacrifice
chapters.summary: Offer your bodies as a living sacrifice and be transformed by renewing your mind. Use your gifts, love sincerely, and overcome evil with good.

chapters.title: Love fulfills the law
chapters.summary: Respect governing authorities and pay what you owe. Owe no one anything except to love one another, for love is the fulfilling of the law.

chapters.title: Do not judge one another
chapters.summary: Believers who differ over food and holy days must not despise or judge each other. Whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.

chapters.title: Welcome one another
chapters.summary: The strong should bear with the weak, as Christ welcomed us. Paul shares his plans to visit Rome on the way to Spain. May the God of hope fill you with joy and peace.

chapters.title: Greetings to friends
chapters.summary: Paul commends Phoebe and greets many co-workers, women and men, in Rome, warns against those who cause divisions, and closes with praise.
